question.text: The BEST-case framework for a distributor's annual performance review of their client portfolio is:

answer.text: Review portfolio fit, re-confirm suitability, recommend rebalancing if needed

explanation.text: The Logic: Annual review includes portfolio fit reassessment, suitability re-confirmation, and strategic rebalancing when warranted. The Trap: Ignoring or churning approaches are poor practice. Cross-Exam Context: Fiduciary good practice. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Block calendar for annual reviews 12-18 months out — consistency wins.
